objective: Request review of a bounded existing local lemma and source-compatible contract proposal; no root closure
claims: For every finite non-tautological CNF F and pivot x, retain clauses omitting x and resolve every x-clause against every not-x-clause, deleting tautological resolvents. For every assignment of other variables, the resulting CNF is true exactly when some extension to x satisfies F. This asserts correctness, not a polynomial size bound.
